actual_task_content_exposure.qualification: This is an instruction-scope content-access account in a shared executor. It is not an OS access audit or an OS isolation claim. Interpreter/runtime library loading is not counted as task source content.

model_effort_tier.qualification: Assigned configuration is reported from the parent task instruction; actual serving identity and applied effort are not independently inspectable here.
model_effort_tier.tier_qualification: Fast was requested; no distinct task tool control or independently verifiable applied service tier was available.

retained_expression: Actual import modules and bindings; the two public API signatures and the exact referenced private interface.
Exact provider protocol field names, marker flag/name, fallback message, code/message precedence, failure result/context field order, CoreErrorType.ModelError, recoverable true and retryable false.
Required evaluation order, separate nested-field captures and lazy nullish candidate expressions; ordinary Number/String/Math normalization and property access.
Fresh FIFO BFS and WeakSet semantics, live array for-of expansion, Object.values snapshot traversal, and early first-failure return.
Context spread/overlay admission and marker gates; ordinary summary key assignment, Object.entries/Object.keys, array every behavior and retained array reference identity.

The existing bounded-by-type summary projection is retained without a new redaction policy or data-retention grant. Required protocol, fields, prose, format and ordinary idioms are not claimed as novel.
discretionary_structure: Private cohesive helpers separate code/message normalization and candidate reads, nonzero classification, summary projection and single-record classification.
The metadata public function owns its local BFS queue and seen set; the unknown-error public function owns its marked/context/original branches and final collaborator delegation.
Helper names, local variable names and source formatting are independently selected implementation structure, with no cosmetic novelty claim.

scope.verification: Manual contract review of this complete source only; byte/hash/line accounting is not a behavioral test.

freeze.qualification: Read-only filesystem modes record a cooperative freeze, not immutability or OS isolation. Do not silently alter either artifact after freeze; preserve any original before a necessary receipt correction.
